nary_nodes.label: Harry Styles receives Guinness World Record for longest Wembley Stadium run
evidence: Harry Styles has been awarded a Guinness World Record for the longest run of concerts at Wembley Stadium after completing 12 sold-out shows.
The pop star has broken the official record for the longest residency by a musician at the venue in a single run, beating Coldplay's previous record of 10 nights in 2025.
